headline: Yi-Chia Chen stretches the ARC-3 lead

sections.text: Yi-Chia Chen added 4.53 to reach 67.49 and remains atop ARC-3. Tufa Labs is second at 56.52, leaving Chen 10.97 clear.
Chen has held the lead since October 8. The top spot stays in the same hands, but the cushion grew in the latest board comparison.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
